stories.title: Fietsmerken Batavus, KOGA en Babboe blijven bestaan, verkocht aan Dutech

en.title: Bicycle brands Batavus, KOGA and Babboe continue operations, sold to Dutech
en.summary: Dutch bicycle manufacturer Accell's brands Batavus, KOGA and Babboe have been sold to Singapore-based investor Dutech following Accell's bankruptcy in August. The sale includes the company's IT platform and Hungarian operations, with potential for staff retention under new ownership.

stories.title: Toenadering China en EU met afspraken over hybride auto’s en zeldzame aardmetalen

en.title: China and EU reach agreements on hybrid cars and rare earth metals
en.summary: China and the European Union have reached agreements regarding hybrid automobiles and rare earth metals during negotiations.

stories.title: China stemt in met beperking uitvoer hybride auto’s naar Europa

en.title: China agrees to limit exports of hybrid cars to Europe
en.summary: After two days of EU-China negotiations in Beijing, China has committed to significantly reducing hybrid car exports to Europe over the next four years, potentially averting a trade conflict.

stories.title: Excuses kabinet aan Q-koortspatiënten die steun overheid misten

en.title: Government apologizes to Q fever patients who missed state support
en.summary: The Dutch government has apologized to Q fever patients who did not receive government assistance during and after the 2007-2010 epidemic, acknowledging insufficient support was provided.

stories.title: Fietsmerken Batavus, KOGA en Babboe vallen in Singaporese handen

en.title: Bicycle brands Batavus, KOGA and Babboe fall into Singaporean hands
en.summary: Dutch bicycle manufacturers Batavus, KOGA, and Babboe have been sold to Singapore-based Dutech Holdings following the insolvency of their parent company Accell. The sale includes Accell's IT platform, Hungarian operations, and potentially part of its workforce.

stories.title: Voormalig VN-mensenrechtenchef Navanethem Pillay wint Nobelprijs voor de Vrede

en.title: Former UN human rights chief Navanethem Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, a former UN human rights chief, has won the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor Navi Pillay is het sterkst mogelijke signaal voor de internationale rechtsorde

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize for Navi Pillay is the strongest possible signal for international rule of law
en.summary: The Nobel Committee's decision to award the Peace Prize to South African judge Navi Pillay is seen as an indirect defense of the International Criminal Court amid expected attacks and sanctions from the incoming Trump administration.

stories.title: VS kondigt sancties aan tegen Internationaal Strafhof in Den Haag, wil hof 'verlammen'

en.title: US announces sanctions against International Criminal Court in The Hague, aims to 'paralyze' court
en.summary: The United States has announced sanctions against the International Criminal Court in The Hague, to take effect largely in April next year. The sanctions aim to restrict the court's transactions, financial resources, and operational capacity.

stories.title: De Nobelprijs voor de Vrede is een sterke keuze voor het geloof in internationale rechtsorde

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize is a strong choice for belief in international rule of law
en.summary: The Nobel Committee's selection of Navi Pillay demonstrates confidence in the value of international legal institutions, moral principles, and human solidarity as priorities.

stories.title: Excuses kabinet aan Q-koortspatiënten: 'Van het kastje naar de muur gestuurd'

en.title: Government apologizes to Q fever patients: 'Passed from pillar to post'
en.summary: Twenty years after a major Q fever epidemic in North Brabant, the health minister apologized on behalf of the cabinet to thousands infected. The government acknowledged failing to provide adequate social support for those who became chronically ill.

stories.title: Kabinet maakt excuses aan Q-koortspatiënten: ‘We hebben steken laten vallen’

en.title: Government apologizes to Q fever patients: 'We have dropped the ball'
en.summary: The cabinet has issued an apology to Q fever patients regarding government shortcomings during and after the epidemic outbreak.

stories.title: Israël fileert toekenning Nobelprijs voor de Vrede: 'Goebbels klapt vanuit de hel'

en.title: Israel criticizes Nobel Peace Prize award: 'Goebbels applauds from hell'
en.summary: Israel condemned the Nobel Peace Prize being awarded to former ICC judge Navi Pillay, with the Foreign Ministry using harsh rhetoric to protest the decision following an ICC arrest warrant against Prime Minister Netanyahu.
